readingMode: All 57 physical pages read completely in sequence, including every introduction column, section divider, proposal and back-cover contact. Original pages 1 and 4 visually checked. No annex in this main file; campaign diptych/decalogue read separately.
territorialScope: 23J general-election programme explicitly linked by the archived July 21 2023 campaign page. Lydia Cañedo Congress candidacy in Alicante only; no inheritance to any other ballot.

coverage.authoredAnalysis: Read the full cover: political programme for general election 23J. Original cover visual confirmation retained separately.
Read the entire president's introduction, election date, autonomous/small-business emphasis and attribution. Statistical and causal claims remain source assertions; not neutral help.
Read exemplary-government section divider in full.

Read the full two-column introduction on responsible public resources, institutional transparency, ethics, accountability and judicial/public trust. Broad principles do not substitute an operational measure.

Read all lifetime political pay abolition, fewer ministries/advisers, judicial-professional selection, transparency with resignation, and two-round electoral-reform proposals. Exact election system and permitted office count absent.

Read all independent annual budget audits, at least 60% programme compliance with dismissal/confidence consequences, open government, autonomous-competence duplication reform and subsidy withdrawal. Union/private-association subsidy wording has charitable/nonprofit caveats; no silent ban on every civil-society grant.
Read economy section divider completely.

Read both introductory columns: enterprise/research, education collaboration, public-private partnerships, financing, strategic sectors, sustainability and inclusive digital skills. Benefits asserted by the party remain forecasts.

Read every general-economy proposal: progressive tax on higher individual/company incomes, business employment incentives, SME finance/training/cooperation and research investment. No numerical progressive-tax schedule.

Read ICO financing, reduced entrepreneurship bureaucracy and the Austrian individual capitalisation account. The account travels with the worker, while existing social security is retained; no contribution rate or automatic replacement of every dismissal right specified.

Read all financial education, second-opportunity law, multiple-payer income-tax and public-private management text. The source makes questionable legal/tax assertions about second payers; keep these attributed and do not reuse as neutral tax advice.
Read all economic transparency/corruption restitution, digital economy and total inheritance/gift tax abolition. Claimed investment/employment effects remain forecasts.

Read every self-employed/SME measure: universal flat contribution regardless of income, reduced worker social-security charges, two-year profit-tax exemption for long-term unemployed new self-employed, replacement-worker cost subsidy 100%, retirement/unemployment parity, family hiring rights and youth entrepreneurship. No exact flat-rate euros.

Read all sectoral tax measures: hair/beauty VAT 10%, lower company notarial costs, 50% new-SME tax reduction first three years, lower electricity VAT, invoices/quarterly VAT, commercial-rent withholding and business-transfer levies. Invoice wording says vencidas y cobradas while rationale says unpaid invoices; VAT rent-withholding legal terminology is unclear. Never silently repair these.

Read all family-care contribution/mutual benefit, professional-driver hours/rests, haulier diesel help, small hospitality agreement, proportional dual-status contribution, targeted hiring and reduced contribution below minimum-wage earnings. Universal flat-rate and lower/proportional exceptions need reconciliation, not invented operational detail.
Read all sustainable-tourism introduction; balances tourism development, environment, local culture and community involvement. No exact tourist-tax rate or blanket tourism ban.

Read all thirteen tourism measures: resource protection, diversified/rural routes, sensitive-destination overload control, campaigns, sustainable infrastructure, training/cooperation, renewables, certification, responsible behaviour, proximity and off-season tourism.
Read education equal-opportunity section divider.
Read both education introduction columns about impartial learning, critical thought, diverse views and equitable resources. No unsupported extrapolation to every textbook or school-financing policy.

Read all ten education measures: stable unified national law, critical thought/curriculum/values/art/civic inclusion, responsible digital tools, research collaboration and adequate funding. No precise GDP share or class ratio.

Read the full vocational German-model minimum 16 company hours/week, anti-indoctrination inspection, Spanish as principal school language, coofficial language as job merit rather than requirement, inspection complaint channels and anti-bullying plan. Language rules are explicit and distinct.
Read housing/urban planning section divider.

Read both columns of housing and infrastructure introduction: affordable building, social rent/fair mortgages, depopulation/connectivity, transport and renewables. Distinguish goals from specific mechanisms.

Read all housing measures: youth public/tax/financial support, balanced rural planning, rental-price control/regulation to avoid disproportionate increases, protected/cooperative homes, refurbishment, participation/accessibility and Mediterranean corridor completion. Exact rent ceiling mechanism and price absent.
Read all urban cooperation, phased roads prioritising traffic/poor condition, interregional rail improvement and sustainable development financing. No universal free transport or every toll removal.
Read green-industry section divider.

Read both environmental-industry introduction columns: resource/waste/emissions efficiency, clean technologies/research, worker training and growth within environmental protection. No exact emissions deadline.
Read all green innovation, strict environmental standards/sanctions, circular reuse/recycling, industrial renewables/efficiency and public-private cooperation measures.

Read every corporate social responsibility, named natural-area protection/restoration, vertical urban forests and animal-welfare consensus proposal. No explicit hunting/bullfighting prohibition or precise universal animal-law repeal.
Read livestock/fishing/food section divider.

Read both primary-sector introduction columns: finance for farming/fishing/livestock, sustainable crop/resource practices, endangered species/artisanal fishing, welfare and traceability. No automatic macrofarm prohibition.
Read all targeted financial support, agricultural research, soil/water/waste/renewables protection, irrigation/rainwater/channel investment and fair-market cooperation.

Read both import conditions and tonnage limits for non-EU countries, efficient irrigation, sustainable livestock, equal sanitary production standards at borders and protected long-term cooperative contracts. Standards and quota measures are distinct; no total food-import ban.

Read Spanish sustainable/local/fair labels promotion and coastal-fishing social-security contributions according to actual earnings. Distinguish from the earlier universal flat self-employed-rate promise.
Read health-quality section divider.
Read both complete health introduction columns: access irrespective of economic situation, stronger primary/specialist services, infrastructure/training/research. No precise new-budget amount.

Read full stable healthcare employment, primary-care investment/staff, administration/finance reform and national interoperable health-card/history/prescriptions. Territorial/legal assertions are source claims, not current medical access advice.

Read medical-prescription hearing aids/glasses/prostheses at social-security cost, more public mental-health staff, orderly qualification training, required qualified staff/materials in public/private care homes and celiac nutrition access. Source does not give a subsidy ceiling or celiac benefit amount.
Read justice section divider.
Read both full justice introduction columns: equity, speed, transparency, rights and institutional reform.

Read accelerated lawful eviction/occupation sanctions without fixed hours; judicial selection thirds by judges, bar lawyers and prosecutors; foreigner repatriation on final conviction OR repeated minor-offence detention with individual proportional evaluation. Preserve alternative triggers, not all immigrants.

Read juvenile vandalism/aggression penalties and guardian responsibility; presumption of innocence in gender-violence proceedings; court technology. Does not explicitly repeal the whole gender-violence law.
Read defence/security divider.
Read both full defence/security introduction columns: stronger armed forces and unified national security rules. No explicit NATO or defence-GDP target.
Read all salary-equalisation groups: local/national/regional police, Guardia Civil, prison staff and military; equipment, psychology and modern facilities. No expenditure percentage.
Read family welfare divider.
Read both complete introduction columns on care, reconciliation, social services for children/older/sick people and vulnerable families. No specified childcare benefit.

Read flexible/staggered/compressed and selectable working hours for care; employer collaboration; reduced special-education cost and general birth-rate support without amount. Not a four-day statutory week.
Read subsidy misuse by disguised companies posing as foundations/associations, faster dependency applications and aid. No maximum deadline is stated.
Read diversity/equality divider.
Read both full equality introduction columns, equal rights/opportunities across gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation and other characteristics. No specific statutory change.

Read same/equal-value work equal pay, compulsory employer salary-scale transparency, objective job evaluation, women's leadership and full gender-violence prevention/victim support/institutional coordination. Preserve programme's court presumption-of-innocence proposal separately.
Read full disability inclusion/access barriers in education/employment/housing/public services and equality/diversity/human-rights education from childhood to adulthood. No fixed disability benefit.
Read culture divider.
Read both full culture introduction columns: childhood access, heritage protection, artist/music support and public participation. No bullfighting policy.
Read reading/library/museum/archive digital modernisation, remote collections, artistic tax incentives and inclusive music education/community instruments. No specified tax percentage.
Read all publisher/social contact details on back cover; no policy or annex.

uncertainties: All numeric positions remain null pending cross-reference, authored question rubrics and independent calibration.
Campaign adoption links establish the offered document identities, not byte equivalence with an unrecovered 2023 snapshot of the PDFs.
Main programme requires 60% fulfilment; linked diptych says 50%. Main professional judicial selection specifies thirds judges/lawyers/prosecutors; diptych says judges. Preserve conflicts.
Invoice VAT main wording says overdue and paid, but rationale and diptych say unpaid; no silent correction. Commercial rental IVA withholding term is legally unclear.
General flat contribution coexists with low-income reduced contributions, dual-activity proportional rates and coastal-fishing income-based rates. Retain exceptions.

Source diagnoses, tax/legal descriptions and predicted effects remain attributed, not neutral factual advice. Broad equality, welfare and environment principles do not establish detailed unmentioned policies.
authorship: Direct whole-document reading and authored analysis; deterministic literal/hash/page verification only. No question or position generation.
